Who this is for

Gifting, minus the guesswork.

Most people do not need another generic gift idea — they need someone to translate goodwill into an outfit he will actually wear. That is the entire service.

  • 01

    More than a gift card.

    When clothing is the gift, the thought is visible. A styled outfit says you paid attention — to his taste, his calendar, and the moment he is walking into.

  • 02

    You know the occasion, not the size.

    Weddings, birthdays, promotions, anniversaries. If you are not certain of his exact size or style, the brief covers only what you know — and every gift includes one free size exchange.

  • 03

    It should arrive ready to wear.

    No assembling pieces from three different stores the night before. The outfit arrives complete, gift-wrapped and boxed — he opens it and gets dressed.

  • 04

    A personal note, included.

    Every gift carries a handwritten note from you. Tell us what you would like it to say, and we will write it properly and tuck it into the box.

  • 05

    A complete outfit, not a single piece.

    We style shirt, trousers, and accessories as one considered look, so nothing about the finished outfit is left to guesswork.

  • 06

    For the men in your life.

    Husbands, brothers, fathers, sons, colleagues — the ones who already dress well, and the ones you would like to see dress better.

How it works

Three steps. One considered gift.

  • 01

    Tell Us About Him

    His sizes if you know them, his style, the occasion, and your budget. A two-minute brief is enough — we ask the right follow-up questions only when we need to.

  • 02

    We Style It

    A complete outfit is curated around the brief, then gift-wrapped with your handwritten note. Want to approve it first? We send a preview before the box is sealed.

  • 03

    Delivered

    Sent directly to him, or to you first if you would rather present it yourself. Specify a delivery date in the brief and we confirm scheduling before you pay.

Preview approval available before sealing

Pricing & Packaging

One flat styling fee. No surprises.

Gifting is priced as a service, separate from the outfit itself. You pay a flat styling and gift-wrap fee, then the cost of the outfit you choose — nothing hidden, no commissions on the pieces we curate.
